LightningComponentBundle.description: AWS S3 Files and Folders Table Component - Displays all files and folders from AWS S3 bucket in a table view with navigation, search, and file operations.
LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: AWS S3 Files and Folders Table

property.name: bucketName
